mapper.select: SELECT UR.cod_Red, R.descripcion FROM usuario_Red UR INNER JOIN red_personal R ON UR.cod_Red = R.cod_red WHERE UR.id_usuario = #{idUsuario} AND UR.habilitado = true AND UR.es_activo = true

SELECT UR.cod_red codRed, R.descripcion, Count(*) cantidad, SUM(CASE WHEN UR.regimen LIKE '%dmini%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) personalAdministrativo, SUM(CASE WHEN UR.regimen LIKE '%sisten%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) personalAsistencial FROM usuario UR INNER JOIN red_personal R ON UR.cod_Red = R.cod_red WHERE es_Activo = true AND id_estado_usuario = '02' AND UR.cod_red = #{codRed} GROUP BY UR.cod_Red, R.descripcion
